# Awesome Semantic ID Generative Recommendation

> 181 papers on generative recommendation with Semantic IDs (SIDs), organized by research problem and primary modified pipeline stage.

## Core Files

- [README.md](README.md): Problem × Stage matrix, per-paper stage changes tables, modality and domain entry points, and the full list of papers.
- [guides/glossary.md](guides/glossary.md): Definitions of every problem, Table 1 value, modality, domain, and evaluation setting.
- [pages/index/stages.md](pages/index/stages.md): Papers grouped by the stage they mainly change.
- [pages/index/modality.md](pages/index/modality.md): Papers grouped by SID tokenizer input modality.
- [pages/index/domain.md](pages/index/domain.md): Papers grouped by application domain.
- [pages/index/code.md](pages/index/code.md): Papers that link to code.
- [pages/index/poi.md](pages/index/poi.md): Papers on POI and local-life recommendation.
- [data/vocab.yaml](data/vocab.yaml): Controlled vocabulary and modality grouping rules.
- [schema/paper.schema.json](schema/paper.schema.json): JSON Schema for `data/papers/<id>.yaml`.

## Papers (181 records)

- [ACERec](pages/papers/acerec.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: V. Efficiency · Stage: Backbone · Changes: ● Backbone; ○ Objective · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: Par. OPQ; Backbone: Non-AR; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: MTP + Ctr. + Aux.; Inference: Scoring · TL;DR: ACERec compresses long Semantic IDs into compact latent tokens with an Attentive Token Merger and adds an Intent Token with a dual-granularity objective, to keep long-ID expressiveness at short-ID cost. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 5
- [ActionPiece](pages/papers/actionpiece.md) · ICML’25 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization; ○ Inference · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: OPQ; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: Ensemble · TL;DR: ActionPiece represents each action as a set of item features and merges co-occurring feature patterns into new tokens, so identical actions get context-dependent tokens instead of fixed independent ones. · [Code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/action_piece) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [AdaSID](pages/papers/adasid.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: II. Uniqueness and Validity · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization · SID inputs: Text + Img + CF · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text+Img; Tokenization: RQ; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: AdaSID regulates Semantic ID overlaps during tokenizer training by relaxing repulsion for semantically compatible items and scaling the rest by local collision load, instead of fixed overlap regularization. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [ADC-SID](pages/papers/adc-sid.md) · arXiv’25 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization; ○ Objective · SID inputs: Text + Img + CF · Domain: E-commerce, Ads · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text+Img+CF; Tokenization: MoE-VQ; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed†; Objective: NTP; Inference: – · TL;DR: ADC-SID adds collaborative information to Semantic ID quantization with alignment strength that adapts to collaborative noise and learned weights for behavioral IDs, instead of uniform alignment and equal weights. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 5
- [Align3GR](pages/papers/align3gr.md) · AAAI’26 · Problem: III. SID–Model Alignment · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization; ○ Objective · SID inputs: Text + CF · Domain: E-commerce, POI / Local, Ads · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text+CF; Tokenization: Dual RQ; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP → DPO; Inference: Beam · TL;DR: Align3GR aligns an LLM recommender at three levels, with dual semantic and collaborative tokenization, bidirectional semantic alignment in behavior modeling, and progressive DPO from self-play and real-world feedback. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [APAO](pages/papers/apao.md) · KDD’26 · Problem: IV. Utility · Stage: Training · Changes: ● Objective · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce, POI / Local · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text; Tokenization: R-KM; Backbone: Enc-Dec / Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP + Rank; Inference: Beam · TL;DR: APAO adds prefix-level losses and an adaptive worst-prefix strategy to training, so correct items survive beam-search pruning, closing the gap between token-level cross-entropy training and beam-search inference. · [Code](https://github.com/yuyq18/APAO) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [API](pages/papers/api.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: II. Uniqueness and Validity · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ○ Representation; ● Tokenization; ○ Backbone; ○ Objective; ○ Inference · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: cross-domain · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: PID (P-SAE); Backbone: Enc-Dec / Dec-Only (AR); Non-AR (PR); Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP + Rank + Aux. / MTP + Rank + Aux.; Inference: C-Beam / Scoring · TL;DR: API reuses feature indices of a pretrained sparse autoencoder as an interpretable Semantic ID vocabulary and trains an adapter to predict indices and strengths, instead of fitting a new vocabulary. · [Code](https://anonymous.4open.science/r/API-C1F9/) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [AtSpeed](pages/papers/atspeed.md) · ICLR’25 · Problem: V. Efficiency · Stage: Inference · Changes: ○ Objective; ● Inference · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce, Movie, Book · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: RQ-VAE; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: Spec. Dec. · TL;DR: AtSpeed aligns a draft model with the target LLM on top-K sequences and relaxes speculative-decoding verification, to speed up beam-search generation of top-K items in LLM-based generative recommendation. · [Code](https://github.com/Linxyhaha/AtSpeed) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [AWARE](pages/papers/aware.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: VI. Generalization · Stage: Training · Changes: ● Objective · SID inputs: Text + Geo · Domain: POI / Local · Settings: cross-domain · Scenario: POI and Local Services; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text+Geo; Tokenization: Geo-Prefix+HClus; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: – · TL;DR: AWARE adds agent-generated narratives about local events, culture, and seasonal trends, grounded in each user's behavior, to LLM-based next-POI generation, whose knowledge otherwise stays fixed after training. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [CAPE](pages/papers/cape.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Inference · Changes: ● Inference · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce, Music · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text†; Tokenization: RQ-VAE†; Backbone: Dec-Only / Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: Multi-task NTP† / NTP†; Inference: Hybrid · TL;DR: CAPE is a training-free plug-in that retrieves co-occurrence-supported tail items outside the beam and fuses co-occurrence evidence into ranking, restoring item-level memorization that shared-prefix generation lacks. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [CapsID](pages/papers/capsid.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization · SID inputs: A: Other (Encoder of each compared baseline, unspecified); B: Text + Img + CF · Domain: E-commerce, Other (Large-scale social media platform) · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Industrial Data, Offline · Representation: Text+CF; Tokenization: Soft-RQ; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: CapsID replaces hard residual quantization with capsule routing, which soft-routes each item across capsules and ends its Semantic ID once confidence is high, so ID length varies per item. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 5
- [CARD](pages/papers/card.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: II. Uniqueness and Validity · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ○ Representation; ● Tokenization · SID inputs: Text + Img + CF · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text+Img+CF; Tokenization: NU-RQ; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: CARD fuses text, image, and collaborative signals into a visual semantic unit before encoding and quantizes it with NU-RQ-VAE, whose learnable non-uniform transformation balances skewed embeddings. · [Code](https://github.com/HAI-UESTC/CARD) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 5
- [CausalDPO](pages/papers/causaldpo.md) · ICML’26 · Problem: VI. Generalization · Stage: Training · Changes: ● Objective · SID inputs: n/a · Domain: POI / Local, Movie, Book · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: LLM-Vocab; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP → DPO; Inference: Scoring · TL;DR: CausalDPO extends DPO for LLM-based recommendation with backdoor adjustment, soft clustering of latent environments, and invariance constraints, to remove spurious correlations that DPO amplifies under distribution shift. · [Code](https://github.com/user683/CausalDPO) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 1
- [ChronoID](pages/papers/chronoid.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ○ Representation; ● Tokenization · SID inputs: Text + Time · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text+Time; Tokenization: RQ-VAE / Par. VQ; Backbone: Dec-Only†; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: Beam† · TL;DR: ChronoID benchmarks time-aware Semantic ID construction across temporal encoding, fusion, and quantization choices, replacing static time-agnostic IDs. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [CID](pages/papers/cid.md) · SIGIR-AP’23 · Problem: II. Uniqueness and Validity · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization · SID inputs: CF · Domain: E-commerce, POI / Local · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: CF; Tokenization: Spectral Clus.; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: CID studies item indexing for the P5 foundation model and proposes sequential, collaborative, semantic, and hybrid indexing, replacing random, title, and independent IDs that cause long outputs or hallucinated items. · [Code](https://github.com/Wenyueh/LLM-RecSys-ID) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 1
- [CITE](pages/papers/cite.md) · Electronics’26 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Inference · Changes: ● Inference · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce, POI / Local · Settings: cold-start (item) · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: Par. OPQ; Backbone: Non-AR; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: Discrim.; Inference: Scoring · TL;DR: CITE adds an item-level transition score with separate source and destination embeddings to a fixed parallel Semantic ID generator, modeling the directed relation between the latest item and each candidate. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [CMRec](pages/papers/cmrec.md) · CIKM’26 Short · Problem: VI. Generalization · Stage: Training · Changes: ● Objective · SID inputs: Text + Img + CF · Domain: Ads, E-commerce · Settings: cross-domain · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text+Img+CF; Tokenization: RQ-VAE; Backbone: Dec-Only†; Tokenizer: –; Objective: NTP; Inference: – · TL;DR: CMRec learns a shared cross-country codebook and synthesizes mixed-country sequences by constrained token substitution, so knowledge transfers at the data level and not only through shared parameters. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [COBRA](pages/papers/cobra.md) · NeurIPS’25 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Backbone · Changes: ○ Representation; ● Backbone; ○ Objective; ○ Inference · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce, Ads · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text+SID; Tokenization: Casc. RQ; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP + Dense; Inference: BeamFusion · TL;DR: COBRA generates a sparse Semantic ID and then a dense vector conditioned on it, trains both end to end, and decodes with BeamFusion, which combines beam search with nearest-neighbor scores. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [CogRec](pages/papers/cogrec.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: III. SID–Model Alignment · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization; ○ Objective · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: R-KM+Graph; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: Multi-task NTP; Inference: CoT+C-Beam · TL;DR: CogRec grounds reasoning in Semantic ID structure through intra-layer graphs, item neighborhoods, and Match, LateralJump, and Explore routing steps, instead of a natural-language rationale weakly tied to the IDs. · [Code](https://github.com/caskcsg/CogRec) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [ColaRec](pages/papers/colarec.md) · CIKM’24 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Backbone · Changes: ● Backbone; ○ Objective · SID inputs: CF · Domain: E-commerce, Food / Recipe · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text+CF; Tokenization: H-KM; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP + Ctr.; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: ColaRec builds generative identifiers from a pretrained collaborative filtering model and generates them from interacted-item content, with an item indexing task and a contrastive loss aligning both spaces. · [Code](https://github.com/Junewang0614/ColaRec) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [CoST](pages/papers/cost.md) · RecSys’24 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization · SID inputs: Text · Domain: News, E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: C-RQ; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: Beam · TL;DR: CoST trains the item tokenizer with a contrastive quantization objective that captures neighborhood relationships between items, instead of the reconstruction loss used by RQ-VAE. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [DACT](pages/papers/dact.md) · SIGIR’26 · Problem: VI. Generalization · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization · SID inputs: Text + CF · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: catalog-change · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text+CF; Tokenization: RQ-VAE; Backbone: Enc-Dec / Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: – · TL;DR: DACT fine-tunes a collaborative tokenizer as interactions drift, with an item-level drift detector and relaxed-to-strict code reassignment, to update Semantic IDs without full retraining or mass ID changes. · [Code](https://github.com/HomesAmaranta/DACT) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [DAS](pages/papers/das.md) · CIKM’25 · Problem: I. Informativeness · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ○ Representation; ● Tokenization · SID inputs: Text + CF · Domain: Ads · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation, Ranking and Reranking; Online Experiment or Deployment · Representation: Text+CF; Tokenization: Dual RQ; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: Beam · TL;DR: DAS optimizes quantization and collaborative alignment in one stage, with multi-view contrastive alignment and dual quantization of users and ads, instead of two-stage alignment that loses information. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
- [DASO](pages/papers/daso.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: IV. Utility · Stage: Training · Changes: ● Objective · SID inputs: Text + Other (Internal 4-level, 2048-code SIDs; input unstated) · Domain: E-commerce, Other (Proprietary user-to-item data, business unstated) · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Industrial Data, Offline · Representation: Text; Tokenization: RQ-VAE; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP → RL; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: DASO reallocates part of each GRPO rollout group to prefix-guided completions at Semantic ID levels where candidates leave the target path and adds a graded prefix reward, unlike vanilla GRPO. · [Code](https://github.com/LucasXinYu/DASO) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 2
- [Deco](pages/papers/deco.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: V. Efficiency · Stage: Backbone · Changes: ● Backbone · SID inputs: A: Text; B: Audio · Domain: E-commerce, Movie, Music · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text / –; Tokenization: R-KM; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP + Aux.; Inference: C-Beam · TL;DR: Deco reads each history item as one fused token, condenses the history into a next-item concept, and runs beam search in a light KV-cached decoder instead of the full backbone. · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [DECOR](pages/papers/decor.md) · SIGIR’26 · Problem: III. SID–Model Alignment · Stage: Backbone · Changes: ● Backbone · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text+CF; Tokenization: RQ-VAE; Backbone: Enc-Dec; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: NTP; Inference: Beam · TL;DR: DECOR refines Semantic ID token embeddings by interaction context and fuses pretrained codebook embeddings with learned collaborative embeddings, instead of static token assignments that overwrite pretrained semantics. · [Code](https://github.com/yliuaa/DECOR.git) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 4
- [DIGER](pages/papers/diger.md) · SIGIR’26 · Problem: II. Uniqueness and Validity · Stage: Tokenization · Changes: ● Tokenization; ○ Tokenizer · SID inputs: Text · Domain: E-commerce, POI / Local · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: Text; Tokenization: Learn. - [DiGR](pages/papers/digr.md) · arXiv’26 · Problem: IV. Utility · Stage: Backbone · Changes: ● Backbone; ○ Objective; ○ Inference · SID inputs: Other (RQ-VAE SIDs, input unstated) · Domain: E-commerce · Settings: none · Scenario: General Item Recommendation; Public Benchmarks · Representation: –; Tokenization: RQ-VAE; Backbone: Dec-Only; Tokenizer: Fixed; Objective: Discrim.; Inference: Scoring · TL;DR: DiGR uses Semantic ID tokens as item representations and scores items with one item-level function, instead of generating tokens, after showing that token decoding adds no ranking expressiveness. · [Code](https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SimGR-C408/) · Setup card: yes · Relations: 3
